q: A ball is projected from level ground with a speed of 30 m/s at 53° above the horizontal. At what time after launch is its velocity perpendicular to the initial velocity? (g = 10 m/s².) (Take sin 37° = cos 53° = 0.6, cos 37° = sin 53° = 0.8.)
s:
Perpendicular means the dot product of v and u is zero.
u = (u cos θ, u sin θ), v = (u cos θ, u sin θ − gt).
u² cos² θ + u² sin² θ − g t u sin θ = 0, so t = {u;g sin θ}.
t = {30;10 × 0.8} = 3.75 s
